facts: The main block is about 62 by 32 feet, with a 13-foot rear lanai, two levels, a basement and an unfloored attic. The east and south entrances have porches and the north has a smaller stoop.
The palace was built in 1838 under John Adams Kuakini. King Kalākaua later remodeled it into a royal residence. The institution maintains the building as a museum.
